description: Read who may read a program: its `visibility` (open or private), the people (`memberUids`) and teams (`teamIds`) listed as readers, the access `revision` to send back when you change them, how its time shows to members outside it (`capacityVisibility`), whether you may change them (`canManage`) and whether this workspace may make a program private (`available`). A program you may neither read nor manage answers `not_found`, as a missing one does. Requires `read` scope and a key that acts as a person.
name: anyforge_get_program_access
title: Get program access
